what: Updated speed-highlight/core gotchas in the wiki
why: The earlier note wrongly said highlightHTML({block:true}) ships self-contained chrome — that bad assumption caused the unstyled-code regression this session fixed.
summary: Corrected the speed-highlight learning: highlightHTML({block:true}) emits a classless root div, so theme CSS keyed off [class*=shj-lang-] never matched. Documented the fix — put shj-lang-<lang> on a wrapper div (src/routes/library/[id]/+page.svelte) as the library's intended theme activation.
